# Monoline UI

> Monochrome React components for developer portfolios, documentation, and editorial interfaces, with typed APIs and Tailwind CSS v4 design tokens.

Monoline UI is published as `@chitrank2050/monoline-ui` on npm and JSR. The documentation site and package source are public.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://monolineui.chitrankagnihotri.com/): Library positioning, installation command, and package summary.
- [Installation](https://monolineui.chitrankagnihotri.com/installation): React and Tailwind CSS v4 integration.
- [Component catalog](https://monolineui.chitrankagnihotri.com/components): All 37 component references.
- [Design-token foundations](https://monolineui.chitrankagnihotri.com/foundations): Color, typography, spacing, radius, and motion contracts.
- [Changelog](https://monolineui.chitrankagnihotri.com/changelog): Release and version history.

## Package and source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/chitranklabs/monoline-ui): Source code, issues, and releases.
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chitrank2050/monoline-ui): Compiled ESM package.
- [JSR](https://jsr.io/@chitrank2050/monoline-ui): TypeScript package and generated API documentation.
- [Author](https://chitrankagnihotri.com): Chitrank Agnihotri.
